about: A warp to a map on another map server (issue #1134). It needs a second rathena map server that hosts moc_fild04 (which the first one doesn't load) and server-move.txt. A test NPC (server-move.txt) warps the player from prontera to moc_fild04 200 200: rathena answers with ZC_NPCACK_SERVERMOVE (0x0AC7), and the client enters the second map server and loads moc_fild04 at that cell. Whispering the second server's copy of the NPC warps back to prontera 156 180 on the first one, and the NPC is unloaded there.
